title: Late Charge Amount on a Rural Home Loans Monthly Payment
content:
**Clause.** A late charge on a Rural Home Loans monthly payment is measured on the monthly principal-and-interest payment on the loan record. The charge is the product's late charge percentage of that payment, no less than the product's minimum late charge and no more than its maximum late charge, rounded to the cent.

## The charge as a definition

1. **Measure:** the monthly principal-and-interest payment shown on the loan record, multiplied by the product's late charge percentage and divided by 100.
2. **Bounds:** that figure is raised to the product's minimum late charge if it is below it, and lowered to the product's maximum late charge if it is above it.
3. **Rounding:** the late charge is the bounded figure rounded to the cent, rounded only at the end.

The product's late charge percentage, minimum late charge and maximum late charge are the figures of the product's schedule of fees and charges.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Suppose a product whose late charge percentage were 5, minimum late charge 15.00 USD and maximum late charge 300.00 USD.

| Monthly principal-and-interest payment | Measured | Bounded | Late charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1531.20 | 76.56 | within the bounds | 76.56 |
| 250.00 | 12.50 | raised to 15.00 | 15.00 |
| 7000.00 | 350.00 | lowered to 300.00 | 300.00 |
| 1234.57 | 61.7285 | within the bounds | 61.73 |

## Basis Q&A

**What payment is the charge measured on?** The monthly principal-and-interest payment on the loan record — not the amount left unpaid and not the payment with its escrow deposit.

**When is the figure rounded?** Once, at the end, after the bounds.
